name: Python Compute
description: Run bounded Python 3 code and check Python source with the Pyright engine used by Pylance.
capabilities: calculate, solve equations and simulate instead of estimating an answer
fit curves, run regressions, correlations and statistical tests on data
solve symbolic, arbitrary-precision and constraint problems with SymPy and Z3
analyze datasets and convert CSV, JSON, ODF, MessagePack and CBOR formats
plot statistical data with Seaborn and return PNG charts and CSV tables
calculate with physical units and convert measurements safely with Pint
read shared artifacts and publish large compute outputs without base64
analyze graphs and networks: paths, centrality and connectivity
encrypt, decrypt, sign and inspect certificates with cryptography
check Python syntax and types with Pyright, the engine that powers Pylance
run Python and report the node's packages, returned values, output and errors

bundle.description: Package set provisioned on the node. core provides NumPy and data utilities; science adds SciPy, pandas, plotting, Pint, SymPy and GMPY2; full adds machine learning, Z3, binary/document formats and cryptography.

memoryMb.description: Default per-call address-space limit in MB. Omit to size it from the node's memory.

maxMemoryMb.description: Highest per-call address-space limit a caller may request in MB. Omit to size it from the node's memory.

maxTimeoutMs.description: Highest per-call wall-clock limit a caller may request. Omit for the full 10 minutes.

maxBackgroundTimeoutMs.description: Highest wall-clock limit for a python_run submitted as a background job, and its default. Omit for 1 hour.

concurrentCalls.description: Calls this node runs at once. Omit to size it from the node's CPU cores.

callsPerMinute.description: Calls this node accepts per minute. Omit to derive it from the concurrency.
